title: Rivers
summary: A self-justifying column whose even margins the browser buys with invisible, ever-shifting whitespace — the rivers running down it are the receipt.
mechanism: CSS text-align:justify with hyphens:none — the layout engine inserts variable inter-word space (absent from the DOM, dropped on copy) and re-throws it live on every width change, producing chance 'rivers'.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
Robert Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style (1992) — 'rivers'
net.art source-vs-render tradition (y-a-v-a: Silencio, Non-finito, Indivisible)
